title: The Scott
description: Gardens, pools and interiors at The Scott resort in Arizona, photographed in 2019.

photos.title: Lagoon ruin
photos.alt: A whitewashed stone ruin with three window openings, its terracotta spouts pouring into a clear lagoon
photos.description: Water runs from the wall into the pool, with dark boulders and a small cascade to one side.

photos.title: Hanging chair
photos.alt: A white rattan hanging chair on two ropes, holding one turquoise and white striped cushion
photos.description: The chair hangs over gravel beside a reed screen, a white building behind.

photos.title: Lagoon pool
photos.alt: A clear turquoise lagoon pool edged with boulders beside a curved white wall enclosing rattan chairs
photos.description: Palms and a tile-roofed wing stand behind the pool under a bright sky.

photos.title: Buffet table
photos.alt: A long wooden buffet table set with bowls, bread baskets and small black label cards
photos.description: The spread recedes toward an orchid centrepiece and potted palms at the far end.

photos.title: Cabana
photos.alt: A timber cabana with sheer white curtains, woven pendant lamps and a long table with rattan chairs
photos.description: A shaded dining space open to the garden and pool beyond.

photos.title: Cornhole board
photos.alt: A dark wooden cornhole board with a turquoise border and palm-tree emblem on bright green turf
photos.description: A lawn game waits in the sun, woven chairs soft in the background.

photos.title: Seats by the ruin
photos.alt: Woven lounge chairs in a circle before a whitewashed stone wall with three window openings
photos.description: The garden ruin seen from its lawn side, white flowers spilling from large pots.

photos.title: Salad bar
photos.alt: Pearly bowls of salad greens with tongs and stacked plates, glass doors open to a garden
photos.description: Daylight from the garden falls across the buffet and an orchid in a birdcage.

photos.title: Poolside lounge
photos.alt: White-framed sofas and armchairs around a low table on a flagstone patio beside the pool
photos.description: A sunny seating area set among palms and plantings at the water's edge.

photos.title: Footbridge
photos.alt: A garden path crossing a small wooden footbridge with dark iron railings and white flowers
photos.description: The path leads on through dense greenery toward stone pillars and a gate.

photos.title: Garden lawn
photos.alt: Wicker and woven chairs scattered on a lawn before oleanders and a white wing with a tiled roof
photos.description: Palm trunks and flowering shrubs frame the lawn in front of a two-storey wing.

photos.title: Palms
photos.alt: Three tall palms in a planted bed of agave and shrubs before a tile-roofed entrance drive
photos.description: The palms rise into a clear blue sky above a covered drive.
